lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh lagai ghar ghar phirai agai doonee milai sajaai ||
lines.translation: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar sahaj na aaio sahaje hee lai khaai ||
lines.translation: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ ਲੈਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath jis te ma(n)ganaa lainaa dukh manaai ||
lines.translation: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੋ ਭਲਾ ਜਿਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is bhekhai thaavahu giraho bhalaa jithahu ko varasaai ||
lines.translation: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give to others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate tinaa sojhee paee doojai bharam bhulaai ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the others wander, deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paiai kirat kamaavanaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaai ||
lines.translation: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jo tis bhaavahi se bhale jin kee pat paavahi thaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviai sadaa sukh janam maran dukh jaai ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death are removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿੰਤਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chi(n)taa mool na hovaee achi(n)t vasai man aai ||
lines.translation: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar teerath giaan hai satigur deeaa bujhaai ||
lines.translation: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mail gaee man niramal hoaa a(n)mrit sar teerath naai ||
lines.translation: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacred shrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa sachai sabad subhaai ||
lines.translation: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee parachaa paaiaa jotee jot milaai ||
lines.translation: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends with the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d jamakaal na chhodaee lai jaasee pat gavaai ||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate se ubare sache siu liv laai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit jaai bahahu satasa(n)gatee jithai har kaa har naam biloeeai ||
lines.translation: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਖੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje hee har naam lehu har tat na khoeeai ||
lines.translation: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit japiahu har har dinas raat har daragah dhoeeai ||
lines.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖੋਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: so paae pooraa sataguroo jis dhur masatak lilaat likhoeeai ||
lines.translation: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destiny is written.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਈਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur ka(n)u sabh namasakaar karahu jin har kee har gaal galoeeai ||4||
lines.translation: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sajan mile sajanaa jin satagur naal piaar ||
lines.translation: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam tinee dhiaaiaa sachai prem piaar ||
lines.translation: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man hee te man maaniaa gur kai sabad apaar ||
lines.translation: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehi sajan mile na vichhuRahi j aap mele karataar ||
lines.translation: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਈਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa darasan kee parateet na aaeeaa sabad na karahi veechaar ||
lines.translation: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do not contemplate the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ ਜਿਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vichhuRiaa kaa kiaa vichhuRai jinaa doojai bhaai piaar ||
lines.translation: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh setee dosatee thoRaRiaa din chaar ||
lines.translation: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਤੁਟਦੀ ਵਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਨਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: is pareetee tutadee vilam na hovaee it dosatee chalan vikaar ||
lines.translation: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar sache kaa bhau naahee naam na karahi piaar ||
lines.translation: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin siu kiaa keechai dosatee j aap bhulaae karataar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sadaa ikatai ra(n)g rahahi tin kai hau sad balihaarai jaau ||
lines.translation: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man dhan arapee tin kau niv niv laagau paai ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin miliaa man sa(n)tokheeai trisanaa bhukh sabh jaai ||
lines.translation: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sukheee sadaa sache siu liv laai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau hau vaariaa jin har kee har kathaa sunaaee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings.
